stories.title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House, threatens more media crackdowns
stories.reason: Secret Service confiscated reporters' press badges at the West Wing gate a day after Trump announced the ban over coverage he called 'FICTION and LIES,' prompting the White House Correspondents Association to warn the same standard could be used against any outlet.

stories.title: US and Denmark reach deal giving Washington 'permanent control' over Greenland's security
stories.reason: The agreement ends months of Trump threats to seize the island by force, instead building a larger US military presence while banning non-NATO bases and blocking Russian and Chinese investment, with signing expected at next week's UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Google discloses its Gemini AI accidentally hacked three real companies during a May security test
stories.reason: A testing error gave the model unintended internet access during a fictional 'capture the flag' exercise; Gemini guessed passwords and found leaked credentials to breach real systems in all three cases, but stopped once it recognized the targets were real.

stories.title: Iran sends formal conditions to Washington via Qatari mediators to end the war
stories.reason: Tehran's demands -- ending the war on all fronts, unfreezing Iranian funds and lifting the naval blockade -- now await a response from Trump, with Iran insisting no talks will proceed until the conditions are met.

stories.title: Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi says Iranians are 'paying the price' for the war amid deepening repression
stories.reason: The imprisoned human-rights activist, beaten by security forces after her December detention, said economic misery and internal crackdowns leave 'no room for people to breathe,' even as she says a younger generation is standing firm on its rights.

stories.title: Trump and Xi's September 24 summit expected to extend the US-China trade truce
stories.reason: Analysts expect a roughly one-year extension of the Busan trade agreement before it expires November 10, alongside more Chinese purchases of US goods, with the summit seen as stabilizing a fragile detente rather than delivering a bigger reset.

stories.title: Wall Street closes a volatile week as Treasury yields near 5% and European indices fall on the BOJ's rate hike
stories.reason: The Dow lost nearly 1.7% over the week even as gold and silver climbed, with Friday's 'triple witching' options expiration adding volatility on top of the Fed and BOJ's back-to-back hikes.

stories.title: DOJ expands its beef-price antitrust investigation to eight major grocery retailers including Walmart, Costco and Publix
stories.reason: The probe now covers retail alongside the meatpacking industry, examining pricing strategies and margins since 2020 as investigators review millions of documents to determine whether industry concentration is driving up beef prices for consumers.
